description: Check whether the user can publish right now. Use it BEFORE create_listing, and whenever the user asks "how many listings can I still post?" or "do I have enough credit?". When you are about to publish, pass the `role` you will use in create_listing and read can_create_for_role — true means go ahead, false means show the user the pay_url instead of attempting the publish; omit `role` for a general overview. Always returns success, membership_key, included (true = listings are covered by the plan), current_active_listings, credit_cost (credits per listing; null when included), wallet_balance, can_pay_from_wallet, can_create_listing and pay_url (set only when the user cannot publish). Paid plans also return max_active_listings and remaining_slots (null = unlimited). The free tier instead caps supply and demand listings SEPARATELY and returns max_active_listings_per_intent, active_supply, active_demand, can_create_supply and can_create_demand — there, can_create_listing is true if EITHER side has room, which is why passing `role` matters: can_create_for_role answers for the side of that role only. Example: role="career_employer" returning can_create_for_role=false with a pay_url means send the user to that link instead of attempting the publish.

role.description: Optional. The role you are about to publish as — the same value you will pass to create_listing. When set, the response adds can_create_for_role for exactly that role. Example: "career_employer".

name: get_entitlements
